metadata.description: Claude Code plugins for working with nonlocally: the research market first, more of the platform over time.

plugins.name: nonlocally
plugins.description: The research market (market.nonlocally.org) in Claude Code: MCP server `market` (read the key from ~/.config/nonlocally/market-key) and skill `market` for research directions and their projects, finding, solving and posting Lean 4 bounty contracts (into a project, public or private), and admin minting and editing of directions and projects.
